home.bioParagraph1: Hello! I'm Fran, a recent Computer Engineering graduate from the University of León (ULE). Having finished my studies and defended my Final Degree Project, I am looking for my first full-time role as a Full-Stack software developer. My goal is to join a team where I can add value and continue growing professionally, whether that's creating custom software for clients or driving the development of an in-house product.
home.bioParagraph2: To get to know me better, I invite you to explore my portfolio. In the projects section and on my personal blog, where I document my progress, you can take a look at the personal developments I regularly work on. In them, I put into practice what I've learned and explore new tools to continue expanding my technical skills.
home.bioParagraph3: If my profile fits what you are looking for, I would love to chat. You can find my email, phone number, and LinkedIn profile in the Contact section.
home.experienceIntroText: My professional profile stands out for high adaptability and a mindset geared towards continuous learning. Through team coordination, I have developed the agility to solve problems under pressure, providing analytical value and maintaining smooth communication with clients and colleagues in both English and Spanish.
home.exp_xeridia_desc: Developed a Jira plugin for user management. Coordinated a 4-person team, taking ownership of key technical decisions and maintaining constant communication with clients and stakeholders.
home.exp_restauracion_desc: Maintained operational efficiency in high-demand environments. Agile incident resolution and quick adaptation to strict safety protocols and standards through coordination and multitasking.
home.exp_estalmat_desc: Participation in an intensive program for the detection and development of mathematical talent. Acquired advanced skills in logic, complex problem solving, and abstract thinking.
